entries.developer_comments: ~ A verb expressing an ongoing action

identity: A four-armed humanoid robot zipping around on bumpy, slow rollers.  At first glance it seems to be some sort of service or industrial machine, but closer inspect reveals it is entirely clad in a thick, bone-like material.  Although its "head" lacks any facial features, it bares a surgical mask and a plastic face shield.  Its limbs end in over-articulated hands, clicking, clacking, and rapidly rotating at the wrist.
